targetAudience: San Diego and La Jolla-area owners of valuable jewelry, diamonds, gold, and luxury watches who are actively searching for a reputable way to sell an item or explore liquidity options. The audience is high-intent Google Search and PMax traffic, generally middle- to upper-income asset owners seeking a discreet, professional evaluation.
icp: A San Diego / La Jolla luxury-asset owner with jewelry, diamonds, gold, or a watch such as a Rolex who wants a clear next step to sell or explore borrowing against the item. The best lead is local to the 4275 Executive Sq, Suite 202, La Jolla office or the surrounding San Diego market and is ready to use the AI appraisal form or call the office.

Direct purchase of eligible jewelry, diamonds, watches, and gold
San Diego / La Jolla in-person appraisal and office consultation

Unapproved item categories, including lab-grown diamonds and unsupported brands
qualificationCriteria: Owns an eligible valuable item such as fine jewelry, a diamond, gold, or an approved luxury watch
Selling intent or interest in a jewelry-equity loan
San Diego / La Jolla local intent or willingness to use the local office
Can provide item photos through the embedded AI appraisal flow

geo: San Diego / La Jolla, California, centered on 4275 Executive Sq, Suite 202, La Jolla, CA 92037. Local office traffic should remain distinct from nationwide mail-in campaigns.
conversionGoal: Generate qualified Google Search and PMax leads through the embedded AI appraisal form, with qualified local phone calls as the secondary conversion path. The page should make the appraisal submission the primary action while preserving Salesforce routing and CTM attribution.
offerPositioning: Lead with a free, no-obligation AI appraisal that gives San Diego-area owners a discreet way to understand their options. Present Diamond Banc as a premium, experienced jewelry buyer and lender with a local La Jolla office, an in-person path, and a clear sell-or-borrow choice. Use proof and process clarity to reduce hesitation, without promising a valuation, payout, loan amount, or approval.
valueProposition: Diamond Banc San Diego gives local owners a straightforward way to get an expert appraisal for jewelry, diamonds, gold, or luxury watches, then choose whether to sell or explore a jewelry-equity loan. The La Jolla office combines local access with Diamond Banc's established appraisal process and Salesforce-routed AI appraisal tool.

- Get a free, no-obligation AI appraisal for jewelry, diamonds, gold, or luxury watches
- Sell outright or explore borrowing against eligible jewelry
- Local San Diego / La Jolla office at 4275 Executive Sq, Suite 202
- Professional, discreet process supported by experienced and GIA-accredited jewelry experts
- Clear trust signals: 5.0/5 Trustpilot, A+ BBB, and third-generation jeweler heritage

messagingGuardrails.rule: Always spell the brand Diamond Banc, never Diamond Bank or DiamondBank.
Never imply customers can purchase jewelry, watches, diamonds, or gold from Diamond Banc.
Never use pawnshop language or position the experience as a pawnshop.
Use free appraisal or quote only with no-obligation framing; do not promise a specific value, payout, loan amount, approval, or return.
Use GIA-accredited gemologists or experienced jewelry experts, never GIA Certified Gemologists.
Do not promote Seller's Agent consignment or Retail Partner services on this route.
Keep sell intent primary and present borrowing as an alternative option, not as a guaranteed financial outcome.

designDos: Use the established Diamond Banc premium luxury visual system and approved logo assets from the existing LP repo.
Make San Diego / La Jolla intent unmistakable in the hero and local-office section.
Reuse the embedded AI appraisal form in the hero and dedicated lower form section without replacing it with a custom lead form.
Use real approved Diamond Banc imagery and real product-context photography; do not fabricate branded luxury items.
Use strong teal / aqua brand accents with restrained luxury neutrals and high-contrast typography.
Keep the phone CTA visible as a styled button with (858) 391-4047, while CTM may swap it at runtime.
Use clear section anchors, centered dual CTAs, and a form-only floating CTA.
Make the La Jolla office address and local path prominent without implying every lead must visit in person.
designDonts: Do not overwrite the live root route or any existing market route.
Do not use generic stock or AI-generated images when approved real assets are available.
Do not use a gradient-only hero in place of the established real hero image.
Do not use yellow divider bars, white circle/down-arrow CTA decorations, split screens, clutter, or generic AI effects.
Do not use em dashes, emojis, retail purchase language, pawnshop language, or unsupported financial promises.
Do not use GIA Certified wording, unverified review counts, or an unapproved BBB logo asset.
Do not add navigation links, social exits, or unrelated website links to the paid landing page.
explicitCustomerPromises: Build one new localized San Diego route at quote.diamondbanc.com/san-diego.
Preserve existing Diamond Banc market routes and the client's embedded AI appraisal form behavior.
Use the client-authorized phone source number (858) 391-4047 in the LP source; do not provision CTM infrastructure in the build.
Maintain conservative financial-services copy and the stated brand/compliance guardrails.
